title: Remove scheduler-sensitive wall-clock assumptions from received-notice tests
outcome: Received-notice deadline tests distinguish the intended boundary using controlled time or distant positive controls, with no false failure caused solely by scheduling delay.
acceptance: received_notice_authority_steps_share_the_remaining_batch_time and received_notice_other_root_read_cannot_restart_its_authority_deadline exercise expiry/nonrenewal without requiring scheduling within one second.
Positive current-source notice controls have a deterministic seam for deadline behavior while real Git correctness controls remain; production source predicates and budget are not weakened.
